title: Ceres — dwarf planet
description: Real data: differentiated dwarf planet — rocky core, icy mantle, briny water; density 2.16 g/cm³ (Dawn mission).

title: Vesta — differentiated protoplanet
description: Real data: basaltic crust, iron core — the source of HED meteorites; density 3.46 g/cm³ (Dawn).

title: Bennu — carbonaceous rubble pile
description: Real data: B-type rubble pile, water-bearing clays and organics; density 1.19 g/cm³ (OSIRIS-REx).

title: Ryugu — carbonaceous rubble pile
description: Real data: C-type rubble pile sampled by Hayabusa2; density 1.19 g/cm³, organic-rich.

title: Comet Halley — dirty snowball
description: Real data: nucleus of ices and dust — ~80% water ice with CO, CO2, dust; density ~0.6 g/cm³ (Giotto).

title: 67P/Churyumov–Gerasimenko — Rosetta comet
description: Real data: porous duck-shaped nucleus, density 0.53 g/cm³; glycine and phosphorus found (Rosetta).

title: Jupiter — gas giant
description: Real data: ~90% hydrogen, ~10% helium; metallic hydrogen interior; density 1.33 g/cm³ (Juno, Galileo).

title: Mars — terrestrial planet
description: Real data: iron core, silicate mantle, basaltic crust; density 3.93 g/cm³ (InSight, orbiters, rovers).
